tbesh_html:
1) to be angry, be vexed, be indignant, be wroth, be grieved, provoke to anger and wrath
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be vexed, be indignant
1a2) to be angry
1b) (Piel) to provoke to anger
1c) (Hiphil)
1c1) to vex
1c2) to vex, provoke to anger

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to trouble; by implication, to grieve, rage, be indignant
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.
